answers.core: I tried implementing it myself in my own add-on, but then again, the limitations just makes it impossible to do.
answers.workaround:
Not really. Here's why:
1. The custom class isn't registered directly to the texture property menu. Only registered to custom resources menu. So I'd need to create a resource for every icons that I have.
2. Implementing a custom texture implementation would allow many more things like online texture or something like that.
